BuildingLink / UX audit & accessibility

Understand today. Design what comes next.

An experience, interface and accessibility audit guiding the evolution of a property-management platform.

Lead UX/UI DesignerJuan Carvajal
THE STARTING POINT

BuildingLink

Residents, property managers and service teams share a platform with multiple modules and dependencies. Before modernizing it, that complexity needed to be made visible.

PROJECT CONTEXT
01 / The challenge02 / The solution03 / Decisions04 / The impact
01

The challenge

Build a clear reference of the current state to support migration to a modern frontend framework and a scalable design system.

02

The solution

I mapped architecture, functionality and As-Is scenarios. The UX/UI audit organized findings by severity, while user flows and accessibility analysis helped prioritize improvements.

03

Decisions that make the difference

01

Map existing journeys before proposing changes.

02

Prioritize issues by severity and effect on the experience.

03

Evaluate accessibility alongside architecture and interface design.

04 / The impact

An evolution guided by evidence

A documented foundation for migration, consistency and accessibility decisions. The original material presents qualitative outcomes without published performance figures.
